scenarios.title: High CPU usage
scenarios.expected_root_cause: A bounded CPU-burning loop inside the selected service saturated the process and increased request latency.
expected_symptoms: Container CPU usage rises for the selected service
Request latency increases while the process is still running
telemetry_signals: Traces for the selected service become slower

scenarios.title: Memory pressure
scenarios.expected_root_cause: The selected service allocated and retained a bounded in-process memory block, raising its working set.
expected_symptoms: Container memory usage steps up and stays elevated until the experiment ends

scenarios.title: Slow API responses
scenarios.expected_root_cause: The selected service delayed ordinary HTTP responses before handling them, so latency rose without a traffic surge.
expected_symptoms: Successful responses become uniformly slow
Error rate stays low unless callers time out

scenarios.title: Elevated HTTP 5xx errors
scenarios.expected_root_cause: The selected service failed a configured share of customer requests with HTTP 500 before normal handling.
expected_symptoms: Customers see intermittent server errors
Successful requests are otherwise unchanged
telemetry_signals: HTTP 500 responses in traces and JSON logs

scenarios.title: Database latency
scenarios.expected_root_cause: SQL statements on the shop database were delayed before execution, slowing every request that touches PostgreSQL.
expected_symptoms: Catalogue, cart, and checkout all slow together
The payment gateway itself stays fast

scenarios.title: Database connection pool exhaustion
scenarios.expected_root_cause: The shop API held all of its SQLAlchemy connections, so new requests timed out waiting for the pool.
expected_symptoms: Customer requests fail quickly with a database availability error
The payment gateway process remains healthy
telemetry_signals: ecommerce_db_connections_checked_out stays at the pool size
Logs contain database connection pool exhausted

scenarios.title: Payment gateway timeout
scenarios.expected_root_cause: The payment gateway answered more slowly than the shop API's 2 second payment timeout, so checkout charges timed out.
expected_symptoms: Checkout fails while browsing still works
Reserved stock is released and the order is marked payment_failed
telemetry_signals: Client spans from ecommerce-shop-api to the payment gateway time out
Payment gateway spans are longer than the caller timeout

scenarios.title: Payment gateway failures
scenarios.expected_root_cause: The payment gateway returned HTTP 502 for a share of charge attempts, and the shop API rolled the checkout back.
expected_symptoms: Checkout fails with a payment error
Catalogue and cart requests continue to succeed
telemetry_signals: Shop logs record a payment gateway failure without a catalogue outage

scenarios.title: Inventory conflicts
scenarios.expected_root_cause: Checkout reservations were rejected as inventory conflicts, so orders were not created and stock totals did not change.
expected_symptoms: Add-to-cart and browsing still work
Checkout returns HTTP 409

scenarios.title: Slow product searches
scenarios.expected_root_cause: Product search handling was delayed inside the shop API, while product detail and other routes stayed closer to their normal duration.
expected_symptoms: Searches with a query string are slow
Opening a product by its direct link is comparatively fast
telemetry_signals: Slow spans and latency only on GET /products when a search query is present

scenarios.title: Slow checkout processing
scenarios.expected_root_cause: Checkout processing was delayed inside the shop API before the order transaction finished.
expected_symptoms: Placing an order is slow
Browsing and search stay responsive
telemetry_signals: Slow checkout spans with a later successful payment child span

scenarios.title: Service unavailability
scenarios.expected_root_cause: The selected service rejected customer traffic with HTTP 503 and was unavailable to its callers.
expected_symptoms: Requests to the selected service fail immediately
The other service can still answer its own health check
telemetry_signals: HTTP 503 responses and app_http_error_count_total on the selected service
Shop checkout errors when the payment gateway is the target

scenarios.title: Dependency timeout
scenarios.expected_root_cause: The shop API gave up waiting for the payment gateway because the gateway's response time exceeded the checkout dependency timeout.
expected_symptoms: Checkout fails with a gateway timeout
Direct catalogue requests continue to succeed
telemetry_signals: Short client timeout spans on ecommerce-shop-api

scenarios.title: Browse traffic
scenarios.expected_root_cause: Concurrent customers browsing the catalogue increased the shop API request rate. No fault flag was enabled.
expected_symptoms: Request rate rises on catalogue endpoints
Responses should still succeed unless the service is genuinely saturated
telemetry_signals: Latency stays near baseline unless the host is actually busy

scenarios.title: Search traffic
scenarios.expected_root_cause: Concurrent product-search traffic increased search request rate and database read time. No fault flag was enabled.
expected_symptoms: GET /products?q= traffic rises
Search latency reflects real database work
telemetry_signals: Request rate and SQL spans for product search

scenarios.title: Checkout traffic
scenarios.expected_root_cause: Concurrent checkout requests from the load-test customer contended for stock and database transactions. Conflicts, if any, come from real inventory updates rather than an injected fault.
expected_symptoms: Paid orders increase
Studio Tote stock decreases
HTTP 409 appears only if stock is actually exhausted
telemetry_signals: Paid order logs and payment approval spans
Possible genuine inventory conflict logs if stock reaches zero

scenarios.title: Mixed customer traffic
scenarios.expected_root_cause: A mix of catalogue reads, searches, and checkouts increased overall shop traffic. No fault flag was enabled.
expected_symptoms: Several customer endpoints show higher request rates together
telemetry_signals: app_http_request_count_total across catalogue, search, and checkout
Order and payment spans only for the checkout portion
